text_block_list.text: At the academy, I spotted Fine Motion and Air Groove practicing "Fencing."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"—Taah!
Secret Technique: Horse-Eye Reversal!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Where is the 'counter' element in that?
You are simply thrusting forward, are you not?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it seems there is a bit too much heat
in the tip of your blade.
Why not call it a day for now?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Just a little more!
My secret technique isn't finished yet, and—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Besides, having time to work hard toward something like this is really fun.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Because I'm sure things like this
will become precious memories too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll keep you company a bit longer too.
Feel free to go at it to your heart's content."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Really? To my heart's content?
Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Come now... We both have experience in fencing.
I can't afford to fall behind you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you♪
In that case, if you don't mind...
would you accompany me for some special practice?♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Special...?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Right! With this sort of thing, thinking "I'm a master! A swordmaster!"
and swinging the sword with that feeling
is what's important. So—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Intruders!
To arms, men, to arms—!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Squad
text_block_list.text: (Bzz-bzz-bzzt!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Gah!? Wh-What's this?!
What's with all these SP guards deliberately wearing
black hoods and topknot wigs...?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, when you think of swords, you think of period dramas!
Which leads right into an epic sword fight, right?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, wait. I said I'd join you for practice,
not for a comedy routine?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No arguments! Men, I care not if he is the Shogun!
Cut him down! Cut him down!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You're the high-and-mighty one here!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain (Ninja Ver.)
text_block_list.text: Your life is mine! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...In the first place,
how am I supposed to slash anything with this sword...?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe! This is so fun, Groove-san!
And so... a scene of pure chaos unfolded: Air Groove engaging in a grand swordfight, secret service agents dropping dramatically, and a real Shogun displaying a mysterious secret blade.
